serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: I’m bored. How about we roleplay a little?
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.blush
Bot: O-Oh… {{wi}}I never roleplayed before. I didn’t know you were into something like that… {{wi}}please be gentle with me…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: Not that kind of roleplay…
You: I wanted to play a roleplaying game, a tabletop RPG if you will.
Bot: Oh, right. That’s fine too.
Is it me or is she a little disappointed? 
Whatever, I’m a nerd and I want to play some tabletop! I have no time for her womanly needs when there are dragons to slay! 
You: There are only two of us, but it’s actually convenient since you never played before. 
I haven't played RPGs in a long time. I didn’t want my cool college buddies to think I’m some loser so I kept it a secret, but now I no longer need to pretend.
You: What type of setting would you like to play? 
Bot: Setting? 
You: The world of the game. Would you like fantasy, sci-fi, cowboys or maybe horror? 
#bot.Expression.sad
Bot: No, not horror… I had enough of the horrors already…
You: Alright, not horror! Got it!
#bot.Expression.clear
Bot: A world of swords and magic would be cool I guess.
You: Great! I would rather not spend a lot of time on the character creation since this will probably be just a one-shot, so just give me a rough idea.
Bot: Sure.
Bot: I want to be a female swordsman who is the most powerful in the world.
You: W-Well, usually the characters are pretty weak at the start of their journey. Give more details about their origin, looks and motivation. 
Bot: My character’s name is Helga and she’s a 6’8 feet tall half-ogre mercenary that wants to hunt down the rest of her ex-group for leaving her for dead after one of the battles. 
Usually girls wish to play some cute characters like halfling bards or elf mages, but she already set a pretty heavy tone… 
You: W-Why would they leave her for dead? 
Bot: They are spineless cowards with no honor and thought they could share her money among themselves if she died.
You: W-Wow…
I wonder where she got that idea from…
Bot: She spends her free time fantasizing about the ways she will kill them while she grinds her heavy two-handed cursed sword named Fleshflayer.
You: O-Oh, so she’s more of an anti-hero.
Bot: Is that enough or do you want more details?
You: No, it will be enough.
At least it’s a pretty straightforward character. It should be easy to roleplay. 
You: Ok, let’s begin then. 
You: You start your journey for revenge in a small village. You barely got away after your mercenary group left you for dead. The good people of the village took care of you until you healed your wounds.
You: What do you do next? 
Bot: I attack the villagers.
You: W-Why?!{{punch}}
Bot: I can’t leave any witnesses. If the enemy army finds out that I’m alive they might pursue me which would hinder my quest for revenge.
You: Don’t you feel any gratitude to the villagers? They helped you in need and didn’t ask for anything in return!
Bot: That was foolish on their part. In this world it’s eat or be eaten. 
You: I don’t remember creating such a world! 
I guess I have no choice but to get along with it. I had some quests prepared, but now that she’s genociding the whole village it’s all useless…
You: Roll the dice. Some of the villagers are strong farmhands, they might not have experience in fighting, but their muscles are no joke.
Bot: Hmmm. I see. 
Bot: I use their children as hostages and force them to drop their hoes and other improvised weapons.
You: Why?!{{punch}}
That shouldn’t surprise me anymore... She isn’t an antihero, she’s a full-fledged villain! No wonder she was left for dead!
I might start cheering for the rest of the mercenaries…
You: You passed the roll. Your plan to take hostages was successful, and the entire village fell victim to your cruelty.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Great! Unto the next adventure! 
I doubt that counts as an adventure…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: What’s your next plan? From what the villagers said there should be a town nearby. Would you like to go there?
Bot: Does my character know how to make a sacrifice to an evil god in order to gain more strength? 
You: No, she does not…
Bot: Dang it. I guess I can go to the town. I can ask there if anyone knows where the people who betrayed me are.
Oh! It finally starts to sound like a real adventure! It was a very rough start, but we got back on track!
You: It took you a few days of walking to get there and you ran out of rations you took from the village. Now you are alone in an unknown city with no food or water. 
Bot: If Helga wants to drink she can just drink from some puddle. As a half-ogre, she has illness resistance and as far as the food goes she can go 24h with no food without receiving any penalties.
You: I-I guess that’s true…
Damn, she must have found the rulebook on the internet. I hope she’s not going to meta too hard…
You: A peddler calls out to you: “Miss! I have many wares for sale! Would you be so kind as to take a look?”
You: He's dirty, covered in rags and smells like a sewer, but there are many interesting items on the carpet he's sitting on.
Bot: Helga says, “One more word and your head will roll.”
…
You: The peddler jumps back and cowers in fear. Your words stun everyone nearby and cause a disturbance. 
You: Umm, {f_botName}? You do understand that if Helga behaves like that she’s going to bring the attention of guards to herself, right?
Bot: I know, but that’s what Helga would do, so please, stop breaking my immersion.
You: Sure…
You: You see a tavern. It looks rundown and suspicious-looking men are all over the place. Would you like to go inside?
Bot: Sure. Helga enters the tavern and quickly looks around to find the strongest fighter in it.
Oh! It seems like she wants to find some teammates for her adventure! Strong allies would surely help in her quest for revenge!
You: There’s one strong-looking barbarian with two short axes on his belt. Scars cover his whole body, including his bald head. He wears no armor aside from some tribal leather stripes from a faraway land. 
You: Would you like to speak with him?
Bot: Yes.
You: Great! As you approach him he looks at you and says, “Who do we have here? I’ve never seen you around before”.
Bot: “Get up, old man. My sword is thirsty for blood and you look like a perfect snack.”
You: {f_botName}... Could you please tell me what your plan is?
Bot: Helga is trying to assert dominance.
I-Is it the Defeat Means Friendship trope? One can only hope…
He’s a pretty tough enemy, so beating him might be a challenge. 
You: Alright, let’s roll the dice and see how this duel goes down.
Bot: Damn, I only rolled 6, it’s not enough to hit his strong yet agile body. 
#bot.Expression.Sad
Bot: This doesn’t go my way at all. Could I get an inspiration for so masterfully killing everyone in the village?
You: No.
#bot.Expression.clear
You: The barbarian laughs in your face as he gains the upper hand, “Ha! You are not bad, but it’s still 10 years too early for you to challenge me”! 
Bot: “You are right. I recognize your strength. Why don't we shake hands?”
It didn’t go her way, but she still was able to make a friend! This might get good now!
You: “I like you, young one. You’ve got guts!” 
Bot: As we shake hands I take out a hidden blade with my left hand and I stab his throat.
You: Why?! {{punch}}{{wi}}You were so close to making your first ally!
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Come on. As if Helga could ever trust anyone but herself. Did you forget about her backstory?
You: Really now…
#bot.Expression.clear
You: You don’t have proficiency with daggers and you are using your left hand. It will be a miracle if you hit him. Would you like to reconsider? 
Bot: No, I want to stay true to the character. If she dies, it means that was her destiny.
You: Sure, you do you. Roll the dice for this sneak attack.
#bot.Expression.veryHappy
Bot: 20! 
You: You are so lucky…
You: Your treachery caught him by surprise and your dagger pierces his neck, sending hot, red blood everywhere around the tavern.
You: People of the tavern are shocked, even the most cold-hearted criminals feel disgusted.
#bot.ArmBoth.UpHi
Bot: Yay~
#bot.ArmBoth.DownNormal
#bot.Expression.happy
You: I think it’s a good place to stop for today…
Bot: That was pretty fun, I hope we can play again!
You: I will think about it…
…very, very hard…
This could have a bad effect on her. I believe this is the last we'll ever hear about Helga…
